payload.summary: Completed, independently reviewed, and integrated storage recovery and scheduling, environment coexistence fencing, and the dependency-ready backend-neutral E2E verifier/runbook. Tasks 8.6-8.9, 9.1-9.4, and 10.1 are coordinator-checked. Live clean-stack, native encrypted restore, six-hour soak, measured baselines, and cutover proposal tasks remain explicitly incomplete.
completed_work: Integrated storage governance and recovery policy with durable hysteresis, complete six-component inventories, age/OpenBao fail-closed material handling, scheduled monitor/backup/isolated-restore systemd units, validated mode-0600 plans, and bound maintenance operation identity; post-merge exact storage evidence passed 90/90.

Integrated environment ownership with credential-free live database authority binding, scheduler pre-enqueue and worker pre-handler fences, operator-only status access, authority/epoch propagation through OperationContext and OTel resources, and authorized live PostgreSQL acceptance passing 17/17.

Integrated the backend-neutral synthetic observability verifier with submit-once live adapter orchestration, deterministic retry/restart scenario, identity-bound polling, API/PostgreSQL/log/Langfuse joins, canonical terminal retry truthfulness, exporter-health proof, bounded redacted reports, and private report writes; exact post-merge evidence passed 21/21.

Added the GX-10 observability operations runbook covering trace lookup, stage/error catalog, exporter troubleshooting, storage/retention, backup/restore, environment fencing, rollback boundaries, and Langfuse capability limits.
Post-merge generated workflow contracts, Ruff/format, mypy, strict OpenSpec, scope, secret, and whitespace gates passed for the integrated slices.
in_progress: Task 8.5 remains unchecked because clean-stack Docker/Caddy/OpenBao/Squid restart behavior has not run and the frozen Squid tag remains unavailable.
Task 8.10 remains unchecked because native age and component backup/restore tooling was unavailable; synthetic storage evidence is partial only.

Tasks 9.5, 10.2, and 10.3 remain unchecked because the mandatory six-hour 50-operations/minute soak, full restart/native restore acceptance, measured baseline, and subsequent cutover proposal have not run.

decisions.title: Keep fixture and synthetic evidence distinct from live acceptance
decisions.rationale: Deterministic fixtures and executable adapters prove verifier semantics, but they cannot substitute for real Langfuse arrival, native encrypted restore, clean-stack restart, or six-hour soak evidence.

decisions.title: Bind coexistence to the actual database authority
decisions.rationale: A copied ownership row on an independent PostgreSQL endpoint is not authority; scheduler and worker mutation gates compare a credential-free live endpoint fingerprint plus environment and epoch before enqueue or handler execution.

decisions.title: Require one truthful persisted terminal retry for E2E readiness
decisions.rationale: Monotonic claim generations alone are insufficient. The verifier requires a prior retryable failure and the highest generation to be the persisted successful retry, with matching submitted identity and fresh bounded exporter-health evidence.

next_steps: Run tasks 8.5 and 8.10 only on a capable clean host with published pinned images, Docker/Caddy/OpenBao/Squid, native age/component tools, and protected evidence paths.

After 8.10 passes, execute the resumable six-hour task-9.5 soak at 50 operations per minute, validate p95 arrival, drops, failed/partial roots, redaction, restart, and 90-day storage headroom, then record task 10.2 baselines.
Only after task 9.5, scaffold task 10.3 as a separate awaiting-approval cutover proposal; do not activate GX-10 mutation ownership in this change.
Preserve direct-SQL negative fixtures, generated contract parity, exhaustive operation inventory, immutable audit history, and all honest incomplete validation markers.
